title: Missed Call to Booked Job: The Full AI Flow, Step by Step

slides.headline: MISSED CALL → BOOKED JOB. THE FULL FLOW, STEP BY STEP.
slides.body: What actually happens when nobody's there to pick up — and the machine is.

slides.headline: 9:47 PM — THE CALL
slides.body: Homeowner's AC dies on a hot night. She calls the first shop on Google. At most shops this rings out — and 85% of callers won't leave a voicemail. They dial the next name. $500–$1,200, gone in 20 seconds.

slides.headline: STEP 1 — THE CALL GETS ANSWERED. EVERY TIME.
slides.body: AI picks up on ring two, any hour. Gets the essentials: name, address, "no cool since 6pm," system age. Sounds like a calm dispatcher, not a robot maze. Real emergencies get escalated to your on-call number.

slides.headline: STEP 2 — IT BOOKS THE JOB
slides.body: It reads your real schedule and offers real slots: "First available is 8–10am tomorrow." Books it, confirms by text. No callback lottery in the morning, no lost-to-the-competitor overnight.

slides.headline: STEP 2B — AND IF SHE HANGS UP EARLY?
slides.body: Missed-call text-back fires in under a minute: "Sorry we missed you — this is [Shop] Air. Need service tonight? Reply here." Texts get roughly double the response rate of callbacks. The lead stays yours.

slides.headline: STEP 3 — YOUR TEAM WAKES UP TO A BOOKED JOB
slides.body: CSR opens the day to: job booked, notes attached, customer confirmed. Tech rolls at 8am. After the job: invoice drafted from notes, review request sent automatically. One phone call, zero humans interrupted at dinner.

slides.headline: THIS FLOW IS FIX #1 IN ALMOST EVERY AUDIT I RUN
slides.body: Because it's the biggest leak: ~25%+ of calls missed, $500–$1,200 each. This week only: free AI Profit Audit for 3 South Florida shops (normally $497) — I'll show you YOUR missed-call number. Comment AUDIT or DM me AUDIT.
